title: Oceanographer says the objects are undersea or subterranean

tellings.quote: But then we have one revelation by the oceanographer last few days who says they are not China, they are not US.

plain: In 2025 an unnamed oceanographer, a scientist who studies the sea, is said to have revealed that the unexplained objects come from under the sea or under the ground, and belong to neither China nor the United States. A former presidential advisor named Harald Malmgren passes this on as something revealed in the days before the interview. If true, it would put the objects' origin on Earth, but not with any known country.
